resolved.rationale: Reviewer A claims: High Severity - Mutation Cache Not Updated on Claim Changes
Reviewer A claims: File: pkg/controller/resourceclaim/controller.go (lines 764-772)

Reviewer A claims: Description: The removal of claimCache.OnAddOrUpdate/OnDelete calls means the mutation cache won't be properly updated when claims are added/updated/deleted. This can lead to stale data being used by the controller, potentially causing incorrect behavior when reconciling claims.
Reviewer A claims: Evidence: The test case TestControllerCreateDeleteRecreate was specifically testing this behavior and was removed, indicating this was a known important functionality.

Reviewer A claims: There may be downstream impacts on components that rely on the mutation cache being properly maintained.
Reviewer A claims: Either restore the mutation cache update calls or provide an alternative mechanism to maintain cache consistency
